# Trip-hammer: two posts and an axle, a beam pivoting on it with a heavy iron head at its end and a
# counterweight at its tail. Rigid: beam, head and counterweight are one object (one bone) whose origin
# is the axle. Rest pose (frame 0) = the head down on the anvil. The beam lifts 30 degrees and drops
# in a 1.5 s loop (18 frames at 12 fps): slow lift, a pause, a two-frame drop. Up Z, the beam along +X.
# A hot bar (unlit) lies on the anvil under the head, and a burst of sparks (unlit, its own bone) flies
# off it for four frames round each strike (16, 17, 0, 1), hidden inside the anvil the rest of the loop.
# Placed in the scene with the axle 1.6 m from the anvil, back-left of it (yaw -22.4), so the beam
# passes above the furnace mouth (z 1.37): the head lands on the anvil face (z 0.84).
new
fps 12
frame range 0 18
material new Wood --base-color 0.290 0.141 0.502 --no-slot
material new Iron --base-color 0.020 0.122 0.224 --no-slot
material new Hot --base-color 1.0 0.557 0.502 --emission 1.0 0.557 0.502 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name PostF --size 1 --location 0 -0.24 0.83
scale 0.18 0.14 1.66
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name PostB --size 1 --location 0 0.24 0.83
scale 0.18 0.14 1.66
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name Base --size 1 --location 0 0 0.08
scale 0.5 0.75 0.16
apply --scale
material assign Iron
select PostF PostB Base
active Base
join
rename Base Frame
# the beam: axle at (0, 0, 1.52), the head's centre 1.6 m out, 0.6 tall, its face 0.68 below the axle
add mesh cube --name Beam --size 1 --location 0.62 0 1.52
scale 2.25 0.16 0.16
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name Head --size 1 --location 1.6 0 1.14
scale 0.36 0.32 0.6
apply --scale
material assign Iron
add mesh cube --name Weight --size 1 --location -0.38 0 1.52
scale 0.24 0.26 0.3
apply --scale
material assign Iron
add mesh cylinder --name Axle --vertices 6 --radius 0.08 --depth 0.62 --location 0 0 1.52 --rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Iron
select Beam Head Weight Axle
active Beam
join
rename Beam Arm
cursor set 0 0 1.52
origin set --to cursor
# the hot bar on the anvil face (z 0.84), across the head's footprint, and the sparks: eight small
# cubes around the strike point (1.6, 0, 0.9), their origin there; frame 0 (sampled) is the full burst
add mesh cube --name Bar --size 1 --location 1.6 0 0.87
scale 0.62 0.14 0.07
apply --scale
material assign Hot
add mesh cube --name S0 --size 0.09 --location 2.005 -0.056 1.081
add mesh cube --name S1 --size 0.09 --location 1.884 0.317 0.990
add mesh cube --name S2 --size 0.09 --location 1.718 0.452 1.048
add mesh cube --name S3 --size 0.09 --location 1.299 0.398 1.111
add mesh cube --name S4 --size 0.09 --location 1.211 -0.069 1.162
add mesh cube --name S5 --size 0.09 --location 1.248 -0.242 1.230
add mesh cube --name S6 --size 0.09 --location 1.605 -0.448 1.171
add mesh cube --name S7 --size 0.09 --location 1.839 -0.383 1.147
select S0 S1 S2 S3 S4 S5 S6 S7
active S0
join
rename S0 Sparks
material assign Hot
cursor set 1.6 0 0.9
origin set --to cursor
select Sparks
frame set 0
set location 1.6 0 0.9
set scale 1 1 1
keyframe insert --channels loc,scale
frame set 1
set location 1.6 0 0.84
set scale 1.35 1.35 1.1
keyframe insert --channels loc,scale
frame set 2
set location 1.6 0 0.74
set scale 0.05 0.05 0.05
keyframe insert --channels loc,scale
frame set 16
set location 1.6 0 0.88
set scale 0.55 0.55 0.6
keyframe insert --channels loc,scale
frame set 17
set location 1.6 0 0.9
set scale 0.8 0.8 0.85
keyframe insert --channels loc,scale
frame set 18
set location 1.6 0 0.9
set scale 1 1 1
keyframe insert --channels loc,scale
keyframe interpolation constant --all
select Arm
frame set 0
set rotation 0 0 0
keyframe insert --channels rot
frame set 9
set rotation 0 -30 0
keyframe insert --channels rot
frame set 14
set rotation 0 -30 0
keyframe insert --channels rot
frame set 16
set rotation 0 0 0
keyframe insert --channels rot
frame set 18
set rotation 0 0 0
keyframe insert --channels rot
keyframe interpolation linear --all
frame set 0
select all
shade flat
export hammer.glb --bake-animations
